name: Bad Münstereifel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Münstereifel (a black lion on yellow above a yellow star on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Münstereifel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Münstereifel arms — lion and star
